_meta.description: Hitter-props affine-logit calibration, refit via fit_hitter_prob_calibration.py against PRODUCTION sim_vs_actual batches pulled from Render (/api/ops/artifacts/export), season_2026_ui_daily_live. Three-way chronological split: FIT 30 days 2026-06-14..08-11 (--batch-dir); VAL 10 days 08-12..08-21 (--val-batch-dir, used for L2 selection AND for per-prop config selection, so it is NOT held out); TEST 10 days 08-22..08-31, touched by neither and used only for the final read below.

held_out_test.verdict: This config beats the 2026-07-17 incumbent on BOTH metrics. The incumbent had gone STALE and was measurably WORSE THAN NO CALIBRATION AT ALL on this window (logloss 0.37889 vs raw 0.37859, brier 0.11860 vs 0.11842) -- replacing it is the change; the gain over raw is logloss-only and Brier is ~flat.

_meta.discharges_prior_followup: The 2026-07-17 _meta excluded doubles_1plus, sb_1plus and triples_1plus as 'plausible but not confidently validated in the time available ... pending dedicated follow-up'. All three are now fitted and all three IMPROVE on the untouched TEST split (doubles 0.4071->0.4010, sb 0.3061->0.2363, triples 0.0753->0.0640 logloss). That follow-up is discharged.
_meta.hits_runs_rbis_deliberately_absent: HRR carries NO entry, deliberately, and the reasoning below CORRECTS the note this field held on 2026-09-01 earlier the same day. WITHDRAWN: 'the fit pins the slope at the clamp floor (a=0.05), therefore HRR's probability carries no usable signal.' The clamp-floor fit was an ARTIFACT OF A CONTAMINATED FIT WINDOW -- 1,422 of 7,074 HRR observations in it (20.1%) were literal zeros from the producer null, while VAL and TEST contained none and the hits_1plus control contained none anywhere. CORRECTED: refit on clean dates only, HRR produces healthy slopes (2plus a=0.772, 3plus 0.789, 4plus 0.929, 5plus 1.137). Its probability is NOT signal-free. THE DECISION STANDS ON A DIFFERENT BASIS: even the clean-data fit REGRESSES HRR on the held-out window (2plus 0.6690->0.6740, 3plus 0.5570->0.5603, 4plus 0.4102->0.4149), so the fitted affine-logit correction does not generalise and HRR is left alone. Adding it later requires a fresh held-out reading, not a re-reading of this note.
_meta.hits_runs_rbis_producer_null_closed: The producer null that todo #624 step 2 was opened for is ALREADY FIXED and step 2 is not actionable. Measured on production 2026-09-01: all 993 zero-probability graded HRR rows fall in 2026-06-04..07-08; from 08-07 every graded HRR row is non-zero. On the batch surface the boundary is exact -- 100% zeros on six dates (2026-06-14..06-25), 0% on all 43 dates from 07-20 onward. CONSEQUENCE FOR ANY FUTURE EVALUATION: a window spanning June/early-July is contaminated for HRR, and the assessment's '14.2% of the prop book is staked off a null' is true of ITS window and false of today. scripts/fit_mlb_prop_calibration.py now detects and excludes wholly-degenerate dates.
_meta.refit_2026_10_06: lane mlb-hr-prop-calibration: 10 of 18 keys replaced by a re-fit on the current engine, by a rule pre-registered before the replay (replace only if holdout log-loss improves >= 0.001 nats/row AND calibration-in-the-large is no worse): hits_1plus, hits_2plus, rbi_1plus, runs_1plus, runs_2plus, total_bases_1plus, total_bases_2plus, total_bases_3plus, total_bases_4plus, total_bases_5plus. The other keys and hr_1plus (separate file) keep their maps.
